dialogue.soulless.sensei.first.1: Another wanderer with a sword on his back... You stand at the gate of my dojo, %1$s, and you did not even bow.
dialogue.soulless.sensei.first.2: Very well. Speak - why have you come?
dialogue.soulless.sensei.who: I am the one who teaches the blade to obey the hand, and the hand to obey the heart. My name is of no use to you.
tooltip.soulless.broken_katana: The sensei's ancestral blade, broken many generations ago
message.soulless.astral_forgot: You feel you have forgotten something
message.soulless.oath_breach: The oath: the blade will not touch the innocent
dialogue.soulless.kitsune.wake.1: *A great white fox slowly opens her eyes. Violet seals smoulder around her.*
dialogue.soulless.kitsune.wake.2: Mortal... It has been long since anyone disturbed my sleep. Why have you come?
dialogue.soulless.kitsune.blade.1: I remember this blade. I remember the hand that held it... and the day it broke.
dialogue.soulless.kitsune.blade.2: The blood of an innocent broke it. Since then I do not come to the dreams of that family.
dialogue.soulless.kitsune.why: Perhaps I will mend it. But first, answer me: why do you need this blade?
dialogue.soulless.kitsune.why_unknown: You do not know? That is more honest than anything I have heard from people in centuries.
dialogue.soulless.kitsune.why_power: Strength without purpose has already broken this blade once. Let us see whether it breaks you.
dialogue.soulless.kitsune.why_protect: So said the one who broke it. Words are worth nothing. An oath is worth something.
dialogue.soulless.kitsune.oath.1: I will reforge it. But first - an oath.
dialogue.soulless.kitsune.oath.2: Swear that this blade will never harm a single innocent soul, and will strike only the unclean and monsters.
dialogue.soulless.kitsune.oath.3: Your own blood is the only blood this blade may spill. That is no sin. It is the price.
dialogue.soulless.kitsune.refuse_confirm: Think. If you refuse, this blade will never be yours.
dialogue.soulless.kitsune.sworn: So be it. Hold the blade tight... and wake.
dialogue.soulless.kitsune.refused.2: Then know the truth. For centuries I have slept here against my will: the Wailing Reaper holds me.
dialogue.soulless.kitsune.refused.3: Seek it in the Nether, in the soul sand valley, at the Soul Altar. Go.
dialogue.soulless.kitsune.sworn_again: The blade is already in your hands. Go.
dialogue.soulless.kitsune.opt.blade: The sensei told me you once enchanted this blade. It is broken.
dialogue.soulless.kitsune.opt.why_unknow: I don't know. The sensei asked me to.
dialogue.soulless.kitsune.opt.why_protec: To protect those who cannot protect themselves.
dialogue.soulless.kitsune.opt.refuse: I cannot give such an oath.
tooltip.soulless.training_katana: The sensei's wooden blade: the same moves, no magic
tooltip.soulless.training_katana.lore: Its grip is worn smooth by many students' hands
message.soulless.parry_unknown: You don't know how to parry yet: the sensei teaches it
message.soulless.training_no_ritual: That is not done with a training blade
message.soulless.cleanse_done: The mountains are quieter. Return to the sensei.
message.soulless.cleanse_reset: You hurt an innocent. The count starts over.
message.soulless.katana_mended: The Legendary Katana is whole again
advancement.soulless.sensei_student.desc: Hold out in the sensei's sparring and learn to parry
book.soulless.family_scroll.1:
The Family History

In days long gone our ancestor bore a blade enchanted by Kitsune herself.

The blade took one price only - its bearer's blood - and turned it into strength.
book.soulless.family_scroll.2:
But one day anger blinded him. He raised the blade against an innocent - and the steel broke in his hands.

Since that night Kitsune does not come to the dreams of our family.
book.soulless.family_scroll.3:
The eldest of the family keeps the broken blade. Only she who once enchanted it can mend it.

The old ones say the white foxes know the way to her.
book.soulless.family_scroll.4:
Let whoever bears this blade one day remember:

the blood of an innocent breaks steel.

One's own blood is only the price.
dialogue.soulless.sensei.offer.1: Learn? Words cost nothing. Show me what your hand is worth.
dialogue.soulless.sensei.offer.2: Take this blade. It is wood, but it holds a blow. When you are ready, stand against me.
dialogue.soulless.sensei.spar.1: Stand facing me, blade in hand. I will strike. Turn the blow aside the moment it comes (right click).
dialogue.soulless.sensei.spar.2: Five clean parries and the skill is yours. Miss, and it will hurt - but not for long.
dialogue.soulless.sensei.spar.start: Watch my shoulder. A glint - and the blow.
dialogue.soulless.sensei.spar.miss2: Do not watch the sword. Watch the shoulder.
dialogue.soulless.sensei.spar.pause: Very well, catch your breath. Tell me when we continue.
dialogue.soulless.sensei.spar.abandon: Leaving? Come back and we will continue.
dialogue.soulless.sensei.spar.done: Good. Now this skill is yours. Your body will remember it even past death.
dialogue.soulless.sensei.cleanse.1: At night the unclean creep up to these mountains. Kill ten of them with the training blade.
dialogue.soulless.sensei.cleanse.2: And remember: not one innocent soul - no beast, no villager - may come to harm by your hand. Touch even one and you start again.
dialogue.soulless.sensei.opt.cleanse_wip: I have not finished with the monsters yet.
dialogue.soulless.sensei.cleanse_wip: Ten creatures. And not one innocent soul. Go.
dialogue.soulless.sensei.shrine.1: I saw. You strike clean and leave alone those who did not deserve it.
dialogue.soulless.sensei.shrine.2: There is something I must show you but cannot tell myself. A scroll is kept in my family's abandoned shrine.
dialogue.soulless.sensei.shrine.3: Here is a map. Bring it to me.
dialogue.soulless.sensei.no_shrine: The shrine is too far from here, I cannot find it. Search the forests and taigas yourself.
dialogue.soulless.sensei.shrine_wip: You have the map. The shrine is in the forest, where the cross is. Bring the scroll.
dialogue.soulless.sensei.confession.2: Yes. My ancestor raised the blade against an innocent - and the blade broke. I was ashamed to say it aloud.
dialogue.soulless.sensei.confession.3: Since then Kitsune has turned from our family. She will not come to me. But to you - she might.
dialogue.soulless.sensei.blade.1: This blade has been kept by us for many generations. It must serve, not lie in a chest.
dialogue.soulless.sensei.blade.3: Only Kitsune can reforge it. If she accepts you.
dialogue.soulless.sensei.fox.1: White foxes live in the northern snows. Sweet berries are the way to their trust.
dialogue.soulless.sensei.fox.2: Sleep under a roof beside the one who trusts you, and keep the blade with you. Sleep under the open sky is not deep.
dialogue.soulless.sensei.after: The blade is yours. Seek Kitsune in your dreams.
dialogue.soulless.sensei.opt.fox_again: Remind me how to find Kitsune.
dialogue.soulless.kitsune.mend.1: You again... and a broken blade again.
dialogue.soulless.kitsune.mend.2: The oath is not broken when steel simply tires. I will reforge it.
dialogue.soulless.kitsune.mended: Here. And take care of it.
message.soulless.harakiri_unknown: You don't know yet what this blade does with R. Ask the sensei
message.soulless.renegade_won: The Renegade is beaten. The sensei should hear of this.
message.soulless.renegade_lost: You come to your senses. He will be back.
advancement.soulless.renegade_beaten.des: Defeat the Renegade in the dark astral
advancement.soulless.harakiri_learnt.des: Learn from the sensei what price the blade takes
dialogue.soulless.renegade.call: At last... The one the old man gave the blade to.
dialogue.soulless.renegade.intro1: Do you know who I am? I stood in that dojo too. I held a wooden blade too.
dialogue.soulless.renegade.intro2: Only I never got it right. He looked at me as if I were nothing.
dialogue.soulless.renegade.intro3: Now let us see which of us is nothing. Give me the blade - or I will take it!
dialogue.soulless.renegade.win: Weak. The blade will not save you. I will come back for it.
dialogue.soulless.renegade.defeat1: How?.. You are... stronger than I thought.
dialogue.soulless.renegade.defeat2: This is not over. Dark magic does not forgive defeat... and neither do I.
dialogue.soulless.sensei.forged.1: Then she accepted you. I was not wrong.
dialogue.soulless.sensei.forged.2: Be careful. Not everyone is glad the blade has returned to the world.
dialogue.soulless.sensei.opt.renegade: I met a man in a hood. He spoke of you.
dialogue.soulless.sensei.renegade.2: He was my student. Training never came to him, and one day he left - for places decent people do not go.
dialogue.soulless.sensei.renegade.3: You held against him. Then it is time for the last lesson.
dialogue.soulless.sensei.harakiri.1: This blade takes one price only - the blood of the one who holds it.
dialogue.soulless.sensei.harakiri.2: Kneel, turn the blade and drive it into yourself (R). It will hurt - three hearts, and it can kill.
dialogue.soulless.sensei.harakiri.3: But Kitsune will see your sacrifice and lend you her strength for a while: a faster blade, fewer blows landing on you.
dialogue.soulless.sensei.harakiri.4: Do not do it without need. And never for pride.
